answer: Each grading seat is salted with canary items whose verdicts the protocol holds. A key's seal weight equals accuracy on those canaries; one wrong call forfeits its 400 POA escrow and voids its seals that epoch. The kernel of the rule is weight as measured accuracy, never volume. Canaries are drawn per key from a shale of past answers, so fifty clones carry fifty exposures, and a wrong verdict traced to one funder slashes every bond beneath it jointly. The canyon between one key and a hundred clones: accuracy cannot be pooled, so the hundredth clone doubles the forfeit without adding a seal.
